uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

4881-6909-7176-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7176-8200.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Carnage to gain all creature types
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

1531-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

618-4142-8095.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

728-1724-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sekki.

Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-5931.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

565-1858-7445--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.

565-1858-7445--118.description:

Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

149-2113-4831.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Cacophodon ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

You have a card in your graveyard.
You have a way to lose life.
679-5435-6282.description:
Lose life by any method.
Lich's Mastery's second ability triggers, causing you to exile a card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to lose 1 life and draw a card.
Lich's Mastery second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Resolve the Lich's Mastery trigger, exiling a card from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Prototype.
When Arcbound Prototype dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Prototype's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Prototype from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

527-4927-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

4875-5310-5686-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5310-5686-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2060-4893-5140-7061.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4893-5140-7061.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

141-3047-6798.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3769-5571-6798--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.

Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent

Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2178-3967-4681-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

Activate Marvin using Palladium Myr's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

Activate the Torch Courier token by sacrificing it.
When the Torch Courier token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Torch Courier token ability, giving target creature haste until end of turn.

Resolve the Mindslaver ability, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During your next turn, activate Captain Sisay by tapping it, searching your library for Mindslaver and putting it into your hand.
Cast Mindslaver by paying {6}.
Repeat.

Cast Teferi by paying {W}{U}.

Draw a card.

The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Symmetry Matrix.
Resolve the Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Tentacle you control.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.

Scaretiller is untapped.

Play Terramorphic Expanse.
Terramorphic Expanse enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate Terramorphic Expanse by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Terramorphic Expanse from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

You have a creature card exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1824-2510-2661.description:

Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Acererak enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
